LanguageData.Rakinia.label: ratkin kingdom
LanguageData.Rakinia.description: Ratkin Kingdom. A non-invasive group of ratkin mostly invisible to humans.
LanguageData.RK_Faction_Pilgrims.label: pilgrim band
LanguageData.RK_Faction_Pilgrims.description: A band of pilgrims traveling for many different reasons. Some are nobles, some are soldiers, some might even be looking for a new home, each has their own reasons for why.
LanguageData.RK_Faction_Caravan.label: Ratkin caravan
LanguageData.RK_Faction_Caravan.description: An independent traveling merchant band that roams the world to trade, or perhaps join, with anyone willing to speak to them.
LanguageData.RK_PlayerFaction.label: Ratkin Settlers
LanguageData.RK_PlayerFaction.description: A recently-formed group of independent Ratkin looking to make a new home for themselves.
